narration.full_text: In this section, we'll set the stage for our journey into real numbers. You'll learn to define and classify real numbers, including the important distinctions between rational and irrational numbers. We'll also dive into the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, understanding its core principles and practical applications. Furthermore, you'll discover how to find the Highest Common Factor and Least Common Multiple using prime factorization. Finally, we'll explore methods to prove the irrationality of numbers like the square root of two, and see how these concepts apply to solve real-world problems.
